name: Early Intervention Centre for Infants and Young Children with Hearing Impairment
benefit: - Infants and young children with hearing impairment are given the training to develop speech and language skills.
_eligibility_text:
1. The beneficiary child should be between 0-6 years. 
1. The beneficiary child should have hearing impairment.
1. The beneficiary child should not have any other disabilities.
